text: I just heard someone say women don't choose bad men. Men hide who they are until they're comfortable. So what happened to that much talked about women's intuition? It suddenly doesn't work anymore? As one of the comments under this video says, the lack of accountability is astounding. Yes, actions have consequences. You make bad choices, you get bad results. If after some time you realize that the person you are with is bad, chances are he or she was already showing signs from the beginning. You either didn't see them or you saw them and chose to ignore them. Because most people are not good at hiding who they are long term. Patterns leak, behavior repeats, red flags show up. The question is whether you pay attention to them or not. And this is not about men or women. This applies to everyone. Guys, don't be like the person in this video. Take accountability for your choices and actions. If after some time you realize that the girl you are with is not the one you imagined her to be, understand something important. This is on you. Maybe you lacked experience. Maybe you ignored the signs. Maybe you wanted a fantasy more than the reality. Learn from your mistakes. Work on your understanding of dating. Work on recognizing patterns. Work on your standards. Because right actions lead to right consequences. And wrong actions lead to wrong consequences. Simple as that.
